controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-* METADATA _id
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T10:34:24.500Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-19T11:34:24.500Z"
| WHERE host.name == "db-1" AND _id == "7e260d27-a577-5826-b340-b13375d95cbf"
